instruction: Display the amount of free disk space directly on my desktop background.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because displaying disk space information on the Ubuntu desktop wallpaper requires installing and configuring desktop widgets or conky-like tools, which cannot be reliably evaluated in the OSWorld environment. Like the original battery percentage task, this involves system UI customization that's not verifiable through standard automation.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - displaying disk space on desktop wallpaper requires third-party tools (Conky, screenlets) that cannot be reliably verified
No standard OSWorld getters can verify text embedded in desktop wallpaper images
System UI customization of this nature is outside the scope of automated verification
Evaluator correctly uses infeasible() function as defined in metrics/__init__.py:170
Metadata explanation appropriately references similar precedent (battery percentage task)
